text: Do you have a technology roadmap tied to your business plan and budget?
Who is managing your technology vendors, contracts, renewals, and costs?
Are your IT procedures documented — or does one person simply know how everything works?
Are you prepared for CMMC, NIST, HIPAA, or your next customer security review?
Do you know your highest cybersecurity risks — and who owns remediation?
Are you confident that critical company data is properly protected and recoverable?
Your employees are already using AI. Do you know what tools they are using, and what information they are putting into them?
If a major technology decision had to be made tomorrow, who would leadership turn to?
